PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Secure player progress, stats, unlocked arsenal, and mission achievements for Street Justice.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the authenticated player.

money.description: Current player cash rewards earned from patrols and missions.

rankName.description: Title of current rank (e.g. Rookie Officer, Detective, Sergeant).

arrests.description: Total criminal suspects subdued and handcuffed.

civiliansRescued.description: Number of civilians protected and questioned.

evidenceFound.description: Forensic evidence clues photographed or logged.

iaViolations.description: Excessive force violations recorded by IA.

unlockedWeapons.description: List of unlocked weapon IDs in the armory.

weaponUpgradeLevels.description: Map of weapon ID to current upgrade Mark tier.

solvedCases.description: List of solved investigation case IDs.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the player profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent cloud sync save.

/players/{playerId}.description: Player progress save documents partitioned by authenticated user ID.
